delta_assessment: Export order follows actual current embedded envelope→three exact scene selectors→paired prepared city/furniture dependency. Each selected core CLI rebuilds validated source and writes only changed output; no all29 export. New processes compile updated include_str inputs. Cloud identity oracle runs after raw/curated source refresh, followed by oak impostor export.

Cloud conditional uses set-euo-pipefail and exact fixed case. Success must report1 passed. Only genuine0-passed/1-failed result permits existing ignored cloud exporter, itself requiring1 passed, then rerun ordinary oracle requiring1 passed. Compilation, empty filter or missing result cannot trigger a successful refresh. A one-case failure is not proof of an identity-only cause: in-case input/prerequisite failure can enter branch, but exporter shares prerequisites and final oracle must pass. No failure is waived by that attempt.

Envelope and oak exporter logs likewise require positive exact1-case success, with --color=never so native libtest summary adapter sees plain text. The two ordinary shrub/leaves suites retain pipefail/status aggregation. Always-upload artifacts can remain stale/partial after failure; docs explicitly require all exporter success, exact revision and paired outputs before copying.

New ordinary Windows job checks requested PR/head revision and records it, unsets envelope write flag, invokes exactly own five existing filters10 current cases on native client/art-demo bins without --ignored, and rejects missing/multiple/zero result summaries. Cargo pipelines stop on failure. Counts/logs are execution evidence, not additional unit cases or runtime portability proof. No normal Linux required cell or acceptance command removed.

Windows toolchain installed before adding configured bundled rust-lld directory to GITHUB_PATH; PowerShell step overrides defaultbash intentionally. Common cache settings retain native compiler/environment invalidation. Runtime installation/link/actual test success remains pending.

Docs accurately distinguish regeneration artifacts, dependent scene/prepared pairs and separate ordinary Linux/focused Windows acceptance. No product source, expected snapshot, generated asset or assertion changes in this delta.
